en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large European town square with formal gardens, walkways, and people strolling or gathering around market stalls. The square is surrounded by ornate multi‑story stone buildings in late‑19th‑century style. Handwritten cursive text in Swedish is overprinted on the lower half of the image. Printed captions include the town name and identify the square. A small imprint at the bottom credits a local bookshop in Sundsvall.
